ms.promise: The output of this milestone is to have a working SDK to fetch data from Blockfrost in the Erlang languange. In this milestone we will release the code for testing up to the public. We do not expect to see much usage, as it will be in beta, for testing and probably not much people will use it in production. People will be able to follow up the progress on Github. The links will be shared with community on Github, Twitter of Blockfrost, Reddit of CardanoDevelopers and StackExchange.
ms.criteria: A working demo script that will use the Erlang SDK will be part of the source code.
ms.report:
・Github repository blockfrost-erlang (source code, documentation and the script snipped in the Usage)
・Twitter post
・CardanoDevelopers reddit post
